sentences.en: A valuable object decreases in value if it is damaged.
sentences.zh: 如果一个有价值的物品受损了，它的价值就会下降。

sentences.en: The explosion did a lot of damage to the building.
sentences.zh: 爆炸对这座建筑造成了很大的破坏。

sentences.en: The flood did a lot of damage to the village.
sentences.zh: 洪水给这个村庄带来了很大的破坏。

senses.zh: 损害, 毁坏, 加害于 -
损失, 损害, 损毁 - 损害赔偿金
